pairs: Tunc cecinit Moyses et filii Israël carmen hoc Domino,
Then Moses and the sons of Israel sang this song to the Lord,
for he has been gloriously magnified:
equum et ascensorem dejecit in mare.
the horse and the rider he has cast into the sea.
et factus est mihi in salutem:
and he has become my salvation.
He is the God of my father,
The Lord is like a fighting man.
currus Pharaonis et exercitum ejus projecit in mare:
The chariots of Pharaoh, and his army, he has cast into the sea;
electi principes ejus submersi sunt in mari Rubro.
his elect leaders have been submerged in the Red Sea.
They descended into the depths like a stone.
Et in multitudine gloriæ tuæ deposuisti adversarios tuos:
And in the multitude of your glory you have put down your adversaries.
Et in spiritu furoris tui congregatæ sunt aquæ:
And by the breath of your fury, the waters were gathered together.
congregata sunt abyssi in medio mari.
The abyss was gathered into the midst of the sea.
My hand will put them to death.’
submersi sunt quasi plumbum in aquis vehementibus.
They were submerged like lead into the mighty waters.
Who is like you in strength,
Dux fuisti in misericordia tua populo quem redemisti:
In your mercy, you have been a leader to the people whom you have redeemed.
et portasti eum in fortitudine tua, ad habitaculum sanctum tuum.
And in your strength, you have carried them to your holy dwelling place.
Sorrows took hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
Then the leaders of Edom were stirred up,
and trembling took hold of the robust of Moab.
All the inhabitants of Canaan were petrified.
Let fear and dread fall upon them,
by the magnitude of your arm.
Let them become immobilized like stone,
Introduces eos, et plantabis in monte hæreditatis tuæ,
You shall lead them in and plant them, on the mountain of your inheritance,
firmissimo habitaculo tuo quod operatus es, Domine:
in your most firm dwelling place, which you have formed,
which your hands have made firm.
Dominus regnabit in æternum et ultra.
The Lord will reign in eternity and beyond.
Ingressus est enim eques Pharao cum curribus et equitibus ejus in mare:
For the rider Pharaoh, with his chariots and horsemen, was brought into the sea.
et reduxit super eos Dominus aquas maris:
And the Lord brought back upon them the waters of the sea.
filii autem Israël ambulaverunt per siccum in medio ejus.
But the sons of Israel walked across dry ground in its midst.”
egressæque sunt omnes mulieres post eam cum tympanis
took up a timbrel in her hand.
And all the women followed her with timbrels and dancing.
for he has been gloriously magnified.
et ascensorem ejus dejecit in mare.
he has thrown into the sea.”
Tulit autem Moyses Israël de mari Rubro,
Then Moses took Israel from the Red Sea,
et egressi sunt in desertum Sur:
and they went forth into the desert of Shur.
And they wandered for three days through the wilderness,
nec poterant bibere aquas de Mara,
They were unable to drink the waters of Marah because they were bitter.
unde et congruum loco nomen imposuit,
he also established a name befitting the place,
And the people murmured against Moses,
So he cried out to the Lord,
qui ostendit ei lignum: quod cum misisset in aquas,
who showed him a tree. And when he had cast it into the waters,
they were turned into sweetness. In that place,
Si audieris vocem Domini Dei tui, et quod rectum est coram eo feceris,
“If you will listen to the voice of the Lord your God,
and do what is right in his sight,
and obey his commands, and keep all his precepts,
cunctum languorem, quem posui in Ægypto, non inducam super te:
I will not bring upon you any of the distress that I imposed on Egypt.
For I am the Lord, your healer.”
Venerunt autem in Elim filii Israël,
Then the sons of Israel arrived in Elim,
where there were twelve fountains of water
And they camped next to the waters.
